drivingQuestion: How many judges measure for the eglah arufah, and from which words?

segments.he: עֲרִיפַת עֶגְלָה בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: ״וְיָצְאוּ זְקֵנֶיךָ וְשֹׁפְטֶיךָ״. ״זְקֵנֶיךָ״ – שְׁנַיִם, ״שֹׁפְטֶיךָ״ – שְׁנַיִם, וְאֵין בֵּית דִּין שָׁקוּל מוֹסִיפִין עֲלֵיהֶן עוֹד אֶחָד, הֲרֵי כָּאן חֲמִשָּׁה. דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: ״זְקֵנֶיךָ״ – שְׁנַיִם, וְאֵין בֵּית דִּין שָׁקוּל מוֹסִיפִין עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹד אֶחָד, הֲרֵי כָּאן שְׁלֹשָׁה.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «the breaking of the heifer’s neck» is performed «in» front of a panel of «three» judges, and that Rabbi Yehuda says there must be five judges. «The Sages taught» in a baraita: The verse states: «“And your elders and your judges shall go out» and they shall measure to the cities that are around the corpse” (Deuteronomy 21:2). «“Your elders”» is in the plural, which indicates a minimum of «two,» and «“your judges”» is also plural, indicating another «two, and» as «a court may not» be composed of «an even» number of judges, «they add an additional one to them,» so «there are five» judges «here;» this is «the statement of Rabbi Yehuda. Rabbi Shimon says: “Your elders,”» indicate «two, and» as «a court may not» be composed of «an even» number of judges, «they add an additional one to them,» so «there are three» judges «here.»

edges.about: the plural nouns זקניך and שופטיך each imply two judges, plus one to break a tie: five
only זקניך counts: two plus one, three
